Welcome!

In this experiment, you will see triplets of simple shapes and choose the odd-one-out.

Press "Continue" to begin.

Please do not close this tab until the experiment finishes.

Thank you for your interest in this study!

The experiment takes approximately 50 minutes. Finishing the full session is required for credit.

Careful, attentive responses are essential for high-quality data. Rushed or ineffortful responses can mask meaningful patterns in how people perceive visual information.

Your thoughtful participation genuinely helps advance scientific understanding of the human mind, and we greatly appreciate your time and engagement.

On each trial, you will see three shapes. You will do 9 blocks in total.

Your task is to select the shape that is the odd-one-out.

There is no strictly correct answer, we are interested in your intuitive judgment.

However, there are also attention check trials.

On these trials, there is exactly one correct odd-one-out (two shapes are identical, and the third looks similar).

    You must answer at least 80% of these correctly in a block to successfully pass that block.

    If you fail 3 or more blocks, your data may be rejected, and you may choose to stop the experiment at any time.

After each block, you will see feedback indicating whether you passed that block.
